name: The Fae Axis
introDiscord:
A brilliant silver line cuts through the Nexus.

Every portal, current, and floating fragment seems to orient around it.

Shizuki drew an arrow saying:

'THIS might actually be north.

Glimmer laughed for seven minutes.'
introTwitch:
A brilliant silver line cuts through the Nexus.

Every portal, current, and floating fragment seems to orient around it.

Shizuki drew an arrow saying:

'THIS might actually be north.

Glimmer laughed for seven minutes.'

the-fae-axis-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The Fae Axis.

left.message: The Axis creates a perfectly stable resting point.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Fae Axis Sentinel appears where the silver line crosses your path.

forward.message: A cache aligns itself precisely with the Axis.

the-fae-axis-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Fae Axis, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
One Berry rests beneath a compass.

Every direction says NORTH.

Shizuki wrote:

'Vindicated somehow.'

right.message: A coffer travels directly along the silver line.

the-fae-axis-threshold.prompt: Near Crossroads of Silver Law, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A Sentinel steps out of the line itself.

right.message: The stable geometry around the Axis restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: Star Candies arrange themselves into a perfect directional arrow.

boss-antechamber.name: Crossroads of Silver Law
boss-antechamber.prompt: The silver Axis splits into six crossing lines.

bossPromptDiscord:
The silver Axis splits into six crossing lines.

One Sentinel stands exactly where all six meet.

Use /yes to enter the Crossroads or /no to remain
directionally confused but alive.
bossPromptTwitch:
The silver Axis splits into six crossing lines.

One Sentinel stands exactly where all six meet.

Use !yes to enter the Crossroads or !no to remain
directionally confused but alive.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Crossroads of Silver Law. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Silver geometry forms around an immense guardian.

Axis Prime Sentinel reveals itself!

completionText:
The silver line continues onward.

Shizuki's newest marker:

'North-ish.'
